entries.subject: [ZST] of length n

entries.subject: struct with DST last field
entries.dynamic_layout: statically sized prefix plus dynamically sized tail under enclosing representation/layout
entries.critical_boundary: tail metadata or DynMetadata::size_of is not generally the whole enclosing size

entries.subject: pointer to unsized T
entries.stable_layout_guarantee: pointer is sized; size and alignment each >= those of pointer to sized T

validity_boundaries: Raw metadata shape alone does not establish dereferenceability.
Wide reference/Box slice metadata must not make total pointed-to size exceed isize::MAX.
Safe slice values require initialized elements.
str additionally requires its UTF-8 invariant.
Raw size/alignment queries impose subject-specific metadata preconditions.
